L0502

Float `==`/`!=` comparison is unreliable (D-SMELLLINT1)

What

Float `==`/`!=` comparison is unreliable (D-SMELLLINT1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for L0502

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0502: tests/ui_lint/float_eq_warn.warn.

Warning [L0502] (float_comparison): comparing floats with `==` is unreliable
  --> tests/ui_lint/float_eq_warn.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     if x == y -> print("approx")
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: floating-point arithmetic is inexact; two values computed differently may not be bit-identical even when mathematically equal
 Fix: compare within a tolerance: `(a - b).abs() < 1e-9`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0502
